title: What a lovely afternoon.
text: Maria introduced us to the neighbourhood of Triana and we tried a number of tapas I wouldn't have ordered on my own.  I am temporarily using a mobility device because of an injury and the guide was very accommodating.
author: Heartfruit

title: Want to know what the locals eat, give this a try.
text: Excellent experience.  We went to where the locals go and got great advice about how to avoid the typical tourist foods.
author: S8004NVtomd

title: A wonderful introduction to Spanish Tapas and drink.
text:
Maria was a brilliant guide, she was very friendly and knowledgable  all the food and drink was delicious not ugly at all.   We enjoyed the small intimate group of 4.  
Overall, a wonderful experience introducing us to Spanish tapas and Spanish drink. Thank you very much, Maria.
author: Mary Jane R

title: Great local food with Paula.
text:
The tour with Paula was very informative and interesting.  As a matter of fact we went to try the restaurant today (Monday) unfortunately it was closed.   
We were going to take her suggestions on how to order their house specials. 
As you can tell, we had a good experience and wanted to repeat it.
author: Pablo G

title: Great experience!
text: Our tour guide was a lovely lady.Very friendly and knowledgeable.Made us feel comfortable straight away. Great choice if you want to go where the locals go and not all the touristy places.Also great communication  regarding having to change date.  I would recommend this tour.
author: H4605GRamandaa

author: Z5903OKstefant

title: Ask for Fabio!
text:
Fabio was a great guide, who told us not just about food but about the city, it's history and the way of life in Sevilla. We could have spend all day listening to him! 
The food was so nice that afterwards it was difficult to find food just as nice... We became spoiled!
He was very kind, like a friend who shows you around. We were a group of 8 women and felt very comfortable with him.
author: Alexandra J

title: Ugly Food tour was awesome!
text: We had some delicious food that I ordinarily wouldn't have tried before. Along with the local history shared by our guide it was fun.
author: chrisbK4667LG

title: Keeping it real
text: Lots of interesting history about Seville and in particular Triana entwined into sampling real tapas and drinks
author: Ken_P

title: Tasty Tapas in Triano
text:
Fabrio met us at the appointed time and we all introduced ourselves.
The group was 7 people from Australia, USA and UK. 
A very friendly group that Fabio engaged with and told us all about the origins of the food. 
Both Tapas bars were local to Tiano and made us very welcome. 
We enjoyed the dry local sherry and the Vino Tinto with lemon soda. 
Each of the dishes was explained to us before sampling. 
Don't worry if you're gluten free as I was well looked after.
author: Sightseer49859470730
